> Wasn't there a clarification that said something like:
> The 'X' on Hidden Strength is the cost of the card. [LSJ 19970224]
>
> and isn't Dragos's ability:
>
> "Dragos does not have to burn blood to pay the cost of combat cards he
> plays"
>
> Therefore isn't LSJ's initial answer correct?

Yes. The X is in the drop of blood on the side of the card, therefore
it is a cost. Dragos can choose X to be 10e100 and still pay zero blood,
preventing up to 10e100 + 1 damage.

Hidden Strength does *not* give the effect "the vampire may burn X to
prevent X more damage" (contrast superior Lightning Reflexes).
